items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when you came to New York and you hooked up with Jackie Mac

ctx.x: Yeah. Boy. Whoa. Forgot about that.
Then the next one that’s listed is Jackie Mac [McLean], One Step Beyond. So I don’t know if you want to get right to that already, or – once we get to Jackie Mac, that’s . . .

When I say his name, you’re going to say oh, of course, the pianist. He’s always going on diets, trying to lose weight. Anyway, Herbie used to play with him. Anyway, the group broke up, with Al Grey and Billy Mitchell. Les McCann.
